attBesluta.text: Seems like high quality for the price. No nicks or burrs in any of the die's. Easy to put together and use. Comes with different die's and fits lots of sizes, making it a versatile bender for around our farm and shop. Makes good bends with the right techniques

Worked well for the price, First bend crimped (chain link fence tube, fairly thick, soft steel). Watched YouTube videos for tips. Pack tube w/sand, use die smaller than tubing, move back and forth along center of bend... not fast, not perfect, but also not multi-thousand dollar bender. Watch videos. If you have some extra money, an air powered ram would be useful if you use it a lot.

My company recently purchased this tool in expectation of using it for 2" exhaust pipe. Even though we did it in small movements, the pipe was crushed and not well bent. Even though the tool wasn't up to our satisfaction, the company was reasonable in their return process. This is what a smaller business like our is looking for... integrity!
